def: combustion, i.e. cremation (of a corpse), or calcination (of lime)

occurrences.text: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the Lord.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
